description.fun: Solosis looks like a single cell: a small, nucleus-like body floating in a gel that seems to stand in for cytoplasm. That special liquid lets it live in any environment, and many say it could even survive the vacuum of space, though a heavy blow can make it leak. It talks with others by telepathy and drives off attackers with psychic power. Its name mixes 'solo' with cell-division words like 'mitosis'.
description.guide: Solosis is a Psychic-type Pokémon that resembles a single cell inside a protective liquid. It communicates by telepathy. It evolves into Duosion, then Reuniclus.
description.tagline: A single living cell wrapped in a gel that survives anything.

description.fun: Duosion's brain has split in two, and the halves rarely think alike, so it sometimes tries to do two different things at once and its actions are utterly unpredictable. When both brains do agree, its psychic power peaks and can supposedly reach more than half a mile. Like the rest of its line it seems modelled on a dividing cell, and its name mixes 'duo' with 'fission' or 'fusion'.
description.guide: Duosion is the evolved form of Solosis, a Psychic-type Pokémon whose brain is split in two. Its psychic power is strongest when both halves think the same thing. It evolves into Reuniclus.
description.tagline: A dividing cell with two brains that rarely agree.

description.fun: Reuniclus could fight with its psychic power, but it prefers to swing its huge arms, made of a special liquid and strong enough to crush boulders. When two Reuniclus shake hands, their brains link into a network that boosts their power. Drinking the liquid around its body is said to grant wisdom; the catch is that it's highly toxic to anything but Reuniclus. It was designed by Keiko Moritsugu.
description.guide: Reuniclus is the final form of Solosis, a Psychic-type Pokémon that controls powerful arms made of liquid with its psychic power. Reuniclus can link their brains by shaking hands.
description.tagline: A brainy cell blob that would rather punch than use psychic power.
